label: OpenJDK (the JDK)

source.title: JEP 496: Quantum-Resistant Module-Lattice-Based Key Encapsulation Mechanism
source.quote: Provide ML-KEM implementations of the KeyPairGenerator, KEM, and KeyFactory APIs, with support for the parameter sets ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, and ML-KEM-1024 standardized in FIPS 203.

source.title: JEP 496: Quantum-Resistant Module-Lattice-Based Key Encapsulation Mechanism
source.quote: Provide ML-KEM implementations of the KeyPairGenerator, KEM, and KeyFactory APIs, with support for the parameter sets ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, and ML-KEM-1024 standardized in FIPS 203.

source.title: JEP 527: Post-Quantum Hybrid Key Exchange for TLS 1.3
source.quote: By default, the JDK’s TLS 1.3 implementation will place the X25519MLKEM768 hybrid scheme at the front of that list, making it the most preferred.

source.title: JEP 527: Post-Quantum Hybrid Key Exchange for TLS 1.3
source.quote: By default, the JDK’s TLS 1.3 implementation will place the X25519MLKEM768 hybrid scheme at the front of that list, making it the most preferred.

source.title: JEP 497: Quantum-Resistant Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm
source.quote: Provide ML-DSA implementations of the KeyPairGenerator, Signature, and KeyFactory APIs, with support for the parameter sets ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, and ML-DSA-87 standardized in FIPS 204.

source.title: JEP 497: Quantum-Resistant Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm
source.quote: Provide ML-DSA implementations of the KeyPairGenerator, Signature, and KeyFactory APIs, with support for the parameter sets ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, and ML-DSA-87 standardized in FIPS 204.

notes: Versions are JDK feature numbers. Each JEP page's Release field was read: JEP 496 and JEP 497 say Release 24, JEP 527 says Release 27 (Status Closed / Delivered).
